summary: Computes a driver's race position by counting how many active drivers rank ahead of the queried driver according to DriverStandingComparator, then returns rank+1. When the session type is 7, returns a direct position value read from the vehicle array instead, skipping the comparator walk.

operations.description: If dword_7C56A4 (session type) equals 7, return the stored position value at dword_5F0738[4656 * a2] immediately.
Direct-position early return from the vehicle array for session type 7.
If dword_5C329C (vehicle count) is greater than zero, iterate over all vehicles to count drivers ranked ahead.
Loop v4 from 0 while v4 < dword_5C329C, incrementing the rank counter v5 when a driver ranks ahead.
Read the driver-index byte of each vehicle from the vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0[v4] at offset 18580.
Call DriverStandingComparator on the current driver index and the queried index a2; a negative result means the current driver ranks ahead.
Increment the rank counter when the compared driver is ahead, skipping the queried driver itself.
Return the rank: number of drivers ahead plus one, or the direct stored position for session type 7.
